confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate; no live listings or price pages were consulted. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable for Chilean regional price levels, while hostel and hotel anchors are less certain, and the 2026 peso level is assumed to be roughly 900 to 1,000 CLP per USD. Cocktail and wine anchors were set from their local price relationship to the beer anchor because direct Arica pricing knowledge is weak. The FX figure comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other mid-sized northern Chilean coastal cities such as Iquique and Antofagasta and against general Chilean regional price levels, with budget and mid-range tiers set below Santiago levels. July is treated as a moderate-demand period.
